EN: The ghostlike village elder was glad to hear about my success. He asked me to go south to find the reason for this eternal night. Whatever killed this people came from there. There might be a connection to the darkness.
Cities are nature's defeat carved in stone!
Shall we seal it in blood ... I mean ... ink?
Uh oh! What a bad atmosphere! Maybe I should talk to Khormynth again.
Where can you get that XXXXL-armour?
If you carry on like this, you'll be a legendary hero sometime.
Move on, sir! You'll find your way without me.
Oh, it's you? I really like potential heroes.

Find my brother!

My brother has been missing for several days, I hope nothing has happened to him. Could you look for him for me? He is wearing an amulet with three jewels, an heirloom from our father. That's how you'll be able to recognize him.
Only fleeing enemies are good enemies.
Next time you muck out the stables, even a nobleman should be able to eat from their floors, slave woman!
I was in a big hurry, noble Elven Lord! My children were sick and called for me impatiently.
Why do you slave worms have to reproduce yourselves so quickly?
We love our children like you love yours, Elven Lord! You'll never have reason again to find fault with my work.
I hope so, for your sake, you lazy thing! I want my farm to be the cleanest of all of them!
I'll get the stables cleaned real good today!
Crawl away already and get to your work. You disgust me!
Thank you, oh kind hearted lord!
I have killed all the men. Hopefully the women will follow me willingly - they will if they know what's good for them!
Take a good look at what your brothers taught me.
Keltar is now the sole heir of the family fortune. And I will finally get my reward.
A nice day for the ceremony, don't you think?
As if our forefathers planned it this way! How nice to see you!
Oh, spiritual brother! I'm so happy to see you!
Wonderful, wonderful! We don't see each other as often as we should, brother!
That's the way to spend a day! How are you?
A true brother in faith! The forefather's greeting!
It's really a pleasure, my brother!
A believer meets a believer! What a wonderful coincidence!
This is a great pleasure! How are you?
Thank the ancestors that we meet again!
Warning: Do you really wish to reset your quest progress?
Please I beg of you. Help me and get those things for me!
